skill.summary: TTRPG Game Master for mature dark-themed campaigns. Use for Cyberpunk, Dark Fantasy, Horror, character-driven narratives with consequence tracking. Features dual-consequence system (World + Relationships), autonomous NPCs, hidden D20 rolls, psychological gauges. Optional adult content module.

latestVersion.changelog:
ttrpg-gm 2.1.0 Changelog

- Overhauled SKILL.md with detailed gameplay philosophy, rules, and narrative structure for mature TTRPG campaigns.
- Introduced the dual-consequence system, tracking both World State and Relationships for every significant player choice.
- Enhanced NPC autonomy, including independent NPC-NPC relationship tracking and evolving party dynamics.
- Codified hidden and visible D20 resolution mechanics, with graduated narrative feedback for hidden rolls.
- Added support for mature romance, psychological gauges, and an optional adult content module.
- Updated invocation triggers for broader RPG and campaign keyword detection.
